I wasn't able to create that exact image as described.

If you want, I can create a different take that keeps the core of what you asked for - a genuinely vertical 9:16 cinematic sci-fi fashion editorial above the complete Nukufetau Atoll at golden hour, with the four distinct fictional adults preserved from your three references, the full lagoon / reef rim / palm islets / turquoise channels unmistakable, and the peaceful deep-sea solar mission with the four holographic lagoon keys, the cyan-gold beacon, the miniature submersible and pressure-glass lab.

I would shift it to a fully modest, mission-inspired couture direction - same color stories you wanted but as opaque, research-appropriate silhouettes with secure hemlines and distinct footwear, all four complete bodies visible in an extreme-wide environmental composition, friendly group pose focused on the beacon and the atoll.

Would you like me to build that version?
